entries.changes:
- Switching archives quickly now keeps your latest choice instead of showing an older result.
- Rescanning one archive no longer stops a scan of another archive.
- Storage maintenance in Settings no longer interrupts an active Library scan.
- Archive changes made in another window appear again after a temporary startup connection failure, without restarting Archeion.

- Changes to different Library, Reader, or Storage settings in separate windows now remain together.
- Retry now loads Settings or Theme Manager after a temporary failure without closing the window.
- Add EPUB now starts at the archive root. A folder chosen in the dialog applies only to that import.
- Compatible theme choices from older archives remain available after upgrade.

- Application settings now recover from an interrupted save before Archeion restores defaults.
- Archive metadata, including saved library and reading state, now recovers.
- The registered archive list can now recover from interrupted or corrupt writes when a valid recovery copy is available.

- Overlapping metadata edits and cover replacements for the same EPUB.
- Metadata edits based on an older EPUB version are rejected before they can replace newer changes.
- EPUB export no longer overwrites an existing same-name file.

- Reader settings now adapt to fixed-layout books so publisher-designed pages keep their intended presentation.
- **Narrow**, **Comfortable**, **Wide**, and **Full** Page Width options.
- Large illustrations now fit the visible Reader area.
- Reader settings now save successful changes quietly while keeping failures visible.

- Improved secondary-text readability across built-in application and Reader themes.
- Long dialog headings, book titles, authors, filenames, and metadata preview values now wrap instead of overflowing or being clipped.
- Action lists now expose standard disclosure and button behavior consistently to keyboard and screen-reader users.
- Library multi-selection actions no longer announce unsupported toolbar keyboard behavior.
- Failed bulk metadata updates are now announced without moving keyboard focus.

- Move About into a standalone window.
- Reuse the existing About window when reopened without changing the active Library state.

- Add All, Installed, and Not installed dictionary views with shared search.
- Improve multi-dictionary definition layout.
- Add search to Keyboard settings.
- Match search fields to Archeion's standard control styling.

- Move Settings into a standalone window that can stay open beside Archeion.
- Make application and Reader themes global across archives.
- Add a standalone Theme Manager for importing, previewing, applying, updating, and deleting themes.
- Reorganize Settings for clearer preferences, shortcuts, archive controls, and maintenance actions.
- Move import defaults to global settings while keeping destination folders archive-specific.
- Improve archive maintenance feedback when switching between archives.

- Add offline dictionary lookup from selected Reader text.
- Add Princeton WordNet, Open English WordNet, and GCIDE support.
- Add dictionary install, enable, reorder, remove, and reinstall controls.
- Add support for common English inflections during lookup.
- Add compatible local StarDict imports.
- Improve multi-dictionary results and catalog filtering.

- Add Duplicates view for exact and probable duplicate EPUBs.
- Add EPUB Issues view for broken links, unreadable content, missing navigation, and other Reader problems.
- Show issue counts and Reader availability before opening affected books.
- Add book actions directly to the new review views.
- Add optional Smart View controls for Duplicates and EPUB Issues.

- Add Find in Book with `Ctrl+F`.
- Add Reader Back and Forward navigation.
- Add Contents, Landmarks, and Pages navigation.
- Add progress-bar seeking with mouse and keyboard controls.
- Simplify the Reader toolbar and keep the page layout stable when it is shown or hidden.

- Improve Reader session cleanup when opening, replacing, retrying, or closing books.
- Improve reading-position persistence during rapid navigation and book changes.
- Improve note, annotation, and Undo reliability.
- Improve Escape behavior, focus return, and export cancellation handling.

- Fix Archeion not closing correctly from the titlebar or other Windows close actions.
- Preserve safe shutdown for pending metadata and preference writes.

- Redesign Quick Actions for faster keyboard-driven commands.
- Manage archives, themes, display density, animations, and collection views from Quick Actions.
- Add a configurable `Ctrl+B` shortcut for the Library sidebar.
- Improve Reader panels, focus return, Escape behavior, and temporary surfaces.
- Improve note autosave, draft recovery, retry handling, and annotation management.
- Simplify bookmark and annotation feedback while keeping Undo where useful.

- Redesign the application shell with a collapsible sidebar and cleaner titlebar.
- Improve performance when sorting, filtering, navigating, and returning from the Reader.
- Improve tooltips, focus behavior, controls, spacing, typography, and feedback.
- Reload custom theme changes without restarting Archeion.
- Improve archive operations, settings persistence, and backup organization.

- Add customizable keyboard shortcuts.
- Add separate display preferences for Books, Folders, and Series.
- Add consistent context menus for book, folder, and archive actions.
- Improve focus, Escape behavior, and action feedback across the app.
- Improve accessibility for reduced motion, forced colors, scaling, and non-hover input.

- Improve scrolling and responsiveness in large libraries.
- Speed up archive scans and reduce unnecessary rescans.
- Keep your place when renaming or moving the current folder.
- Improve cover loading and Reader file handling.
- Reduce unnecessary disk writes when saving progress and preferences.
- Refresh interface spacing, controls, and the About dialog.

- Open footnotes and endnotes without leaving the current page.
- Support internal EPUB links and confirmation for external links.
- Add an illustration viewer with zoom and pan controls.
- Save original EPUB images through the Windows save dialog.

- Add application themes and Reader themes.
- Add support for custom color themes.
- Add a Theme Manager for managing installed themes.
- Save theme selections with each archive.

- Add bookmarks, highlights, colors, and notes in the Reader.
- Add a unified panel for browsing and managing annotations.
- Recover annotations after EPUB content changes when possible.
- Export annotations as Markdown or JSON.
- Refresh the Library, Reader, Settings, dialogs, and Archive Manager interface.

- Add multi-select and bulk actions for books.
- Import EPUBs with drag and drop.
- Replace embedded EPUB covers with safe writeback and rollback.
- Add Continuous reading mode.
- Add Quick Actions with `Ctrl+Shift+P`.

- Browse and search EPUB chapters from the table of contents.
- Browse books by series with volume ordering and Continue Series.
- Filter books by metadata, reading status, favorites, and cover availability.
- Add Smart Views for unread, in-progress, completed, and incomplete metadata.
- Clear saved reading progress without affecting other book data.

- Create and open local EPUB archives.
- Browse books with search, sorting, favorites, and Continue Reading.
- Read EPUBs with saved progress and configurable typography.
- Add, rename, move, reveal, and delete books and folders.
- Edit EPUB metadata with safe writeback and backups.
- Manage multiple archives.
